How Arcane Gems work

  • Unlocks after clearing Stage 12-10 on Hell difficulty. Each awakened hero can equip 1 Arcane Gem and uses its skill in battle.
  • Stars are raised by consuming copies of the same gem (0★ to 5★).
  • If the hero's Exclusive is Lv.4 or higher, the equipped gem can go up to 2 extra stars (6★–7★). These extra stars are lost when the gem is removed.
  • A 5★ gem can be disassembled into Primordial Shards: Elite ×1, Epic ×2, Legend ×3.
  • Removing or swapping a gem of Epic quality or higher costs Primordial Potions.
